answer_1.quote: We propose a Paraphrase Augmented Response Generation (PARG) framework ... which jointly optimizes dialog paraphrase and dialog response generation.
answer_1.outputs: dialog system responses and paraphrased user utterances

answer_2.quote: We use three metrics for evaluation... Entity Match Rate (EMR) ... Success F1 (Succ.F1) ... we use BLEU to evaluate the language fluency of generated responses. ... We use the evaluation metrics proposed by ..., which are how often the system provides an correct entity (inform rate) and answers all the requested information (success rate), and how fluent the response is (BLEU).

answer_4.quote: We use one-to-one comparison to evaluate the relative quality of paraphrases generated by PARG versus strong baselines ... we ask the judges to choose whether the paraphrase generated by PARG is of better, equal or worse quality ... The judges evaluate the quality of a paraphrase according to its similarity of user intent with the original utterance.
answer_4.guideline: Judges compare paraphrases and select better, equal, or worse based on similarity of user intent with the original utterance.
